1495. 13. October. Krumau. - Peter von Rosenberg bestätigt den von den Rosenberger Bürgern dem Pfarrer daselbst zu reichenden jährlichen Zins sowie auch andere von der Mühle und dem Bräuhause in Rosenberg zu beziehende Einkünfte.

CCXCI. My Petr z Roznberka haitman kralowstwie Czeskeho etc. wyznawame tiemto listem wssem wuobecz a przedewssemi,, ktoz geig vzrzie anebo czlucze slysseti budu, ze gest przedstupil przed nas cztihodny kniez Jan fararz kostela swateho Mikulasse w Rozn- bercze, caplan nabozny nass mily, a zprawil nas, kterak drzij niektere platy a duochody diedicznie w miestie nassem Roznbercze, na kterez ze gsu priuilegia a dostateczna vtwrzenie od nassich przedkuow temuz kostelu w Roznbercze a fararzom wedle wssie potrzeby dana byla, ale dluhosti czasuow a skrze nepokoge ze gsu zmarzena a potraczena, prosse nas pokornie, abychme my w tom ten bozij duom a sprawedlnost geho ginym nowym vtwrzenim opatrzili, kterzizto plati a duochodi tuto ze gmena wypsani gsu, naiprw Caspar Kraiczij wedle mustu z domu na swaty Girzij dwanadczte peniez a na swaty Hawel tolikez; item ktoz w tom domu piwo warzij, powinen gest fararzi dati do roka padesat peniez; Janek Sladownijk z domu na swaty 367 Girzij dwanadczt peniez a na swaty Hawel tolikez, a ktoz w tom domu piwo warzij, powinen gest fararzi dati do roka padesat peniez; Caspar Knap z domu na swaty Girzij deset peniez, na swaty Hawel tolikez; Petr Sswecz z domu na swaty Girzij deset peniez, na swaty Hawel lolikez; Hanns Schrol z domu na swaly Girzij deset peniez, na swaty Hawel tolikez; Mikulass Tulecz z domu na swaty Girzij deset peniez, na swaty Hawel tolikez; Petr Tkadlecz ze dwu zahradek na swaty Girzij cztyrzi penieze, na swaty Hawel tolikez. Take kniez fararz ma we mlynie miesstskym, kteryz slowe „stalmüll" desatu nedieli dwa diely desateeznie muky a trzetij diel przislussie mlynarzi. Take czoz w desate nedieli sladuow melij, magi dati fararzi od kazdeho sladu dwa penieze; na mlynie Pesser- holczowie ma p fararz rownie takowez prawo a sprawedlnost, yako na swrchupsanym mlynie, kteryz slowe „statmüll". We wsy rzeozene Schawflaren z chalupy na swaty Girzij osm peniez a na swaty Hawel tolikez. Y znamenawsse my geho prosbu pokornu a snaznu, nechtiecz, aby skrze takowy nedostatek tomu boziemu domu a fararzom iaka vigraa aneb prziekaza dieti se miela, na ty wieczi gsme se sami skrze se y take skrze vrzedniky nasse s piluosti wyptali, a tak gsme tomu dostatecznie srozumieli, ze plati a duochodi swrchupsanij k Roznberskemu kostelu z starodawna przislusseli gsu a fararzi Roznbersstij wssiczkni, puokudz z registr starych se sUedawa, y take iakz lidska pamiet gest wzdyczky toho platu a tiech duochoduow gsu diedicznie wdrzenij a vziwanij byli s plnympanstwim. Protoz s dobrym a waznym rozmyslem a raddu dospielu przedesslu swrehupsaneho platu a duochoduow nadepsanych swrchupsanemu fararzi w Roznbercze nynieissiemu, y take wssem geho buduczim potwrdili sme a moczij listu tohoto potwrzugem, tak aby oni toho platu y tiech dnochoduow wzdyczky na wiecznost w prawym diedicznem drzenij a vziwanij byli s plnym a czelym panstwim, tak iakoz gsu prwe wzdyczky byli, a iakoby ta wsseczka priuilegia a potwrzenie , kteraz gsu byla na to od przedkuow nassich wydana, w teto mierze w swe moczi mieli, kteryzto nedostatek my tiemto listem naplnugem, a to bez prziekazi nas.sk>, nassich bratrzij y wsseeh nassich diediezow a buduczijeh y bez zmatku wsselikterakeho. Toto toliko w te wieczi przimienugicz, puokudz gsu swrchupsanij poddanij knirze fararze Rnznberskeho, kterziz w tom miestie domy swe a byt swoig magi powinni s ginym miesstiany nassimi ktere powinnosti trpieti, aby w tom tak stali a 368 tak se zachowali bez odporu wsselikterakeho. Tomu na pewnost a na potwrzenie peczet nassi wlastnij rozkazali sme prziwiesiti k tomuto listu. Genz gest dan na Krumlowie leta bozieho tisiczieho cztyrzsteho dewadesateho pateho w utery przed swatym Hawlem. Das bekannte grössere Siegel des Urkundenausstellers.
entries.english:
1495, 13 October, Krumau. Peter von Rosenberg confirms the annual rent payable by the citizens of Rosenberg to the parish priest there, as well as other income due from the mill and brewery in Rosenberg.

CCXCI. I, Petr z Roznberka, captain of the Kingdom of Bohemia, etc., make known by this letter to all and everyone who sees it or hears it read that the reverend priest Jan, parish priest of the church of Saint Nicholas in Rosenberg, our dear chaplain, appeared before us and informed us that he holds certain hereditary rents and revenues in our town of Rosenberg, for which privileges and proper confirmations had been granted by our ancestors to that church in Rosenberg and its parish priests as needed. Through the passage of time and unrest, however, these had been lost and destroyed. He humbly asked us to provide anew for that house of God and its rights by a new confirmation. The rents and revenues are listed below. First, Caspar Kraiczij, from the house by the bridge, owes twelve pfennigs at Saint George's Day and the same at Saint Gall's Day; whoever brews beer in that house must also give the priest fifty pfennigs a year. Janek Sladownijk owes twelve pfennigs from his house at Saint George's Day and the same at Saint Gall's Day; whoever brews beer in that house must also give the priest fifty pfennigs a year. Caspar Knap owes ten pfennigs from his house at Saint George's Day and the same at Saint Gall's Day; Petr Sswecz owes ten pfennigs from his house at Saint George's Day and the same at Saint Gall's Day; Hanns Schrol owes ten pfennigs from his house at Saint George's Day and the same at Saint Gall's Day; Mikulass Tulecz owes ten pfennigs from his house at Saint George's Day and the same at Saint Gall's Day. Petr Tkadlecz owes four pfennigs from two gardens at Saint George's Day and the same at Saint Gall's Day.

The parish priest is also entitled at the town mill, called the “stalmüll,” to two thirds of the flour as a tithe every tenth week; the remaining third belongs to the miller. Whatever malt is ground during a tenth week, they must also give the priest two pfennigs for each malt measure. At the Pesserholczowie mill, the priest has the same right and entitlement as at the mill described above, called the “statmüll.” In the village called Schawflaren, the holder of a cottage owes eight pfennigs at Saint George's Day and the same at Saint Gall's Day.

Taking his humble and earnest request into consideration, and wishing to prevent any loss or harm to that house of God and its priests arising from this deficiency, we made careful inquiries ourselves and through our officials. We have thereby established satisfactorily that the rents and revenues listed above have belonged to the church of Rosenberg from of old, and that all the parish priests of Rosenberg, as far as can be learned from old registers and human memory, have always held and enjoyed them hereditarily with full rights. Therefore, after mature and careful deliberation, we have confirmed and by this letter affirm to the present parish priest of Rosenberg and all his successors the rents and revenues described above, so that they may hold and enjoy them forever as hereditary property, with full and undivided rights, just as they have always held them before, and as if all the privileges and confirmations issued for this purpose by our ancestors remained in force in this matter. By this letter we remedy the deficiency, without prejudice to us, our brothers, all our heirs and successors, and without any confusion whatsoever. We add only this condition: insofar as the above-mentioned subjects of the parish priest of Rosenberg have houses and dwellings in that town, they must bear and observe the obligations they owe alongside our other townspeople, and must abide by them without any resistance.

As a sign and confirmation of this, we have ordered our own seal to be attached to this letter. Given at Krumau in the year of Our Lord 1495, on Tuesday before Saint Gall's Day. The issuer's familiar large seal.
